kickoff_implementation: Data quality check requires zero blank categories

kickoff_implementation: Data quality check requires every closed row to have resolved_at

objective: Keep categories meaningful for Dana and Priya

objective: Prevent credential leakage through GitHub

objective: Keep changes reviewable and reversible
